description: Dense checkpoint storage map derived from the published Qwen3.8-27B config and safetensors headers. It is not a VRAM fit or tok/s measurement.

notes: Component counts come from safetensors header shapes, not from loading the checkpoint.
BF16 tensor bytes sum to 55562855904, matching the index metadata total_size.
codebook_mib is an explicit zero: the dense index has no codebook tensors.
48 of 64 text layers are linear attention. Their recurrent state is not given a byte formula.
This row does not claim 8k fit, quality, or 25 tok/s.
